title: Install & Play NETFLIX on Mi TV 4A 32" & 43" after Android 9 Update - Tech Singh
description: How to Install and Play Netflix on Mi TV 4A 32" and 43" after Android 9 Update. Follow the steps carefully.  Download Netflix APK for Mi Tv: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1m5TKPyXn_5ZmpXUC6BccHxJuEtcaRxNI  Buy Air mouse keyboard remote  1) https://amzn.to/2QPKAQC 2) https://amzn.to/2N12yNV 3) https://amzn.to/2OCDdIm  Watch Video using Air Mouse Remote with Mi TV: https://youtu.be/k2djLRoQj3g  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  To buy  Mi TV 4X 4K 65 inch: http://fkrt.it/T7e0k4uuuN  Mi TV 4X 4K 43 inch: http://fkrt.it/!lUrwPNNNN  Mi TV 4A Full HD 40 inch: http://fkrt.it/TWc9A4uuuN  Mi TV 4C PRO 32 inch HD Ready ANDROID TV: https://amzn.to/32FJutD  Mi TV 4A PRO 32 inch HD Ready ANDROID TV: http://fkrt.it/GaAOMfuuuN  Mi TV 4A PRO 43 inch Full HD ANDROID TV: https://amzn.to/2UV6ZMO  MI TV 4A PRO 49 inch Full HD ANDROID TV: https://amzn.to/31rYPy4  Mi TV 4X 55 inch 4K ANDROID TV: http://fkrt.it/1IlckoNNNN  MI TV 4 PRO 55 Inch 4K ANDROID TV: https://amzn.to/2LPdyMT  Mi Soundbar (White): http://fkrt.it/C!e09oNNNN  Mi Soundbar (Black): http://fkrt.it/dTIypfuuuN    Follow me on  INSTAGRAM: https://www.instagram.com/mrtechsingh  FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/mrtechsingh  TWITTER: https://twitter.com/mrtechsingh  #mitv #mitvnetflix #netflixonmitv

asr.full_text: hi there so when I received the Android 9 update on my me TV for a 43 inches I was super thrilled but disappointed that there is no official Netflix app yes we did get Amazon Prime YouTube and Google Play Store but Netflix was missing so in this video I'm going to show you how to install and play Netflix on your me TV after the Android 9 by update but before that subscribe to my channel and press the bell icon so that you don't miss any updates. This is your friend Tech Singh, Let's get started… First thing, Download the Netflix APK file from the link given in the description. Move the downloaded file to the desktop and rename it Netflix for Mii TV. Copy the APK file to your pen drive. You can use a Windows PC or laptop. I am using a Mac. But the process is the same. Make sure you safely eject your pen drive from your laptop plug the pen drive on the usb port on the mi tv you will see a pop-up click on the usb just in case there is no pop-up go to the app launcher media player navigate to your pen drive go to the folder where you saved your netflix apk file click it and install once installed go to the home page in the app launcher and you won't see the Netflix app so you go to the play store and search for a TV launcher click install go to the home page app launcher open the atv launcher and you will see the netflix app here so every time you want to watch netflix you have to open the atv launcher click netflix you will get a pop up that a newer version is available click cancel do not update this version of the app or it won't work. Enter your Netflix login and password. There you go. So the good thing about this version is it can be used with the Me TV remote. You can navigate you can scroll through movies. You can play movies very easily using the remote. Let's play a movie. And there you go. This was perfectly fine clear and lag free. To access subtitles or change the audio you will need the air mouse remote. If you want to search for content, scrub between movies you need it. Actually the air mouse keyboard is very handy for this app. It also has a full quality keyboard, which will help you type quickly I highly recommend you get this it's selling for 999 rupees. I'll leave the links in the description if you like to buy one to check it out Also, you can download Netflix movies and videos to your TV using this app You can watch it later offline if you don't have a stable Wi-Fi connection This is something even the official Netflix app doesn't have. So make the best of it. But don't go downloading like crazy as there is limited internal memory on your TV. Use it smartly. This method and app will also work for the MeTV 4a 32 inches. Now something that many of you must be thinking and want to ask me. Will we see the official Netflix app on the first generation MeTVs? Well, there is no official word on this, it is very unlikely that it will happen, but let us hope for the best I hope this video was helpful. Write down in the comments and let me know if this worked for you. If this didn't work for you. Also don't forget to like, share and subscribe, until next time cheers.
